

```{r}

library(cowplot)
library(httpgd)
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(yardstick)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(vroom)

# to generate a comparable dataset
# take all the genomes that are in eukdetect, intersect them with all the species in metaphlan, then intersect them with all speices in eukdetect1

genbank_taxid_mapping <- vroom("/storage/scratch1/1/jshih41/eukaryotic_genomes.tsv") %>% 
    select(species = `Organism Name`, everything()) %>%
    mutate(
        species = str_replace_all(species, "[^[:alnum:]]+", "_"),
        species = str_remove_all(species, "^_+|_+$"),
        species = tolower(species)
    ) %>%
    group_by(species) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()

metaphlan_species_list <- 
    vroom("archive/mpa_vJan26_CHOCOPhlAnSGB_202605_species.txt", delim = "\t", col_names = c("sgb", "taxa"))  %>%
    separate_rows(taxa, sep = ",") %>%
    filter(str_detect(taxa, "k__Eukaryota")) %>%
    group_by(sgb) %>%
    mutate(num_species_in_sgb = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(species = str_replace(taxa, "^.*?s__", "")) %>%
    mutate(
        species = str_replace_all(species, "[^[:alnum:]]+", "_"),
        species = str_remove_all(species, "^_+|_+$"),
        species = tolower(species)
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      genbank_taxid_mapping %>% rename(taxid = `Organism Taxonomic ID`), by = "species"
    )

eukdetectv1_taxa <- 
vroom("/storage/project/r-alind6-0/shared/data_swap/johnathan/eukdetect1_db/specific_markers_only_per_taxid.txt", delim = "\t") %>%
    select(taxid = TaxID, eukdetectv1_markers = Specific_markers) %>%
    filter(!is.na(eukdetectv1_markers)) %>% 
    distinct(taxid, .keep_all = TRUE)
    # filter(!is.na(eukdetectv1_markers))

intersect_sim_mapping_df <-
    vroom("simulation_runs/sim_all_euk_genome_mixtures/all_euk_genome_mapping.csv") %>%
        select(species, taxid, acc, full_acc) %>%
        semi_join( # only in both eukdetect2 and metaphlan
            metaphlan_species_list, by = "taxid"
        ) %>%
        semi_join(  # only i both eukdetect2, metaphlan, and eukdetect1
            eukdetectv1_taxa, by = "taxid"
        ) %>%
        anti_join( # check if there were any missed, these should be filtered out by the previous semi_join
            vroom("simulation_runs/sim_intersect_mixtures/species_to_exclude_not_in_eukdetectv1.txt", delim = "\t", col_names = "species") %>% 
            mutate(species = str_replace_all(species, "_", " ")), by = "species"
        )

# sim_species <- intersect_sim_mapping_df %>% pull(taxid)
# metaphlan_species_list %>%
#     filter(!(taxid %in% sim_species)) %>%

set.seed(123)
intersect_sim_mapping <- 
purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(1000), function(id) {
    intersect_sim_mapping_df %>%
        slice_sample(n = 10) %>%
        mutate(mix_id = id)
}) %>%
    group_by(mix_id) %>%
    mutate(
        # sim_fcov = runif(n(), 0, 0.25),
        sim_fcov = exp(runif(n(), log(1e-5), log(1))),
        normalized_fcov = sim_fcov / sum(sim_fcov)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(full_acc, mix_id, sim_fcov, normalized_fcov, everything()) %>% count(full_acc) %>% View

intersect_sim_mapping %>%
  write_csv("simulation_runs/sim_intersect_mixtures/intersect_sim_mapping.csv", col_names = TRUE)
```
